budget: No new paid subscription; no parameter search; no main merge/deploy/writer

capitalization.age_limit_note: Conservative source-age gate fixed during input-only validation, before any TopK forward-label access; no universe deletion, it marks ranks blocked.
capitalization.classes: No summing duplicate company-level provider caps for two listed classes; distinct class shares/prices or documented equivalent-share convention required
capitalization.fallback: Most recently publicly available actual common shares outstanding x signal-date as-traded USD close, labelled reported-total-cap estimate; no weighted-average EPS shares, book equity or par value
capitalization.input_price_basis: Reuse corrected raw_close or invert original registered split/dividend recipe; validate scale; unknown basis blocks rank
capitalization.unquoted_common_classes: Economic-equivalent listed-price estimate; BRK A=1500 B, ERIE B=150 A; Alphabet B=one A while quoted A and C valued separately; Fox and News classes valued separately. Accenture X and Charter voting-only B are not common economic units. Unreconciled Up-C LLC economic interests block ranks.
capitalization.visibility: Filing date strictly before signal; reported share end-date <=signal; retain filing/period age; quotes on signal date only

costs.source: existing US decision pilot realistic costs; self financing; SPY same costs

entry: First US session after signal at close
exit: entry session index + H at close; maturity as-of 2026-11-13
financial_controls: Reproduce original factor rule and dated single-CIK inputs with SEC asset overlay on corrected financial pool only; no production or old evaluation executor
holding_rules: Dividend reinvestment on the registered total-return basis; never apply dividends to TR twice
Known cash terminal proceeds stay zero-interest USD; verified stock successor stays invested under documented contract
Unresolved fractional settlement or rights remains unavailable; no invented share count, no replacement of selected security
metrics: mean/median/win rate/p10 of net portfolio minus net SPY fixed-horizon USD total return
same-date market-cap versus equal weight difference
company and sector concentration top1/top5/HHI/effective count
weekly-rebalanced segment NAV, drawdown, turnover and costs

nav.continuity: Maximal consecutive verified rank and price-path segments; no stitching or restart to hide missingness; segments shown separately; data-gap endpoint right-censored, not synthetic liquidation
nav.frequency: weekly rebalance on each verified signal next-session close; distinguish from independent H126/H252 fixed-holding cohorts

overlap.bootstrap: Moving-block mean CI with block lengths ceil(H/5)=26/51 weeks, within consecutive supported runs, 2000 draws seed340253; show sparse effective nonoverlapping blocks; no iid significance claims

pre_outcome_input_validation: All ranks frozen again before first forward-label access after correcting the loader so a short followup raw-price window augments rather than deletes earlier original raw quotes.
Normalize dated membership share-class hyphen vs dot when joining SEC CIK/sector metadata. Never change constituent list or use future membership to replace an unpriced security.
Unobserved official index events and index IWF remain unavailable. The observed-snapshot total-cap estimate is a separate diagnostic.
publication: Aggregate research tables and metadata; raw market payloads, per-security future returns and ranking files remain outside git
rank_freeze: Persist every selected company/security, weight, all-universe cap evidence and K-specific boundary status privately, hash ranking files before opening forward holding-return data or evaluating a path
signal_grid: Last US session of each complete week, 2013-01-04 through 2026-09-11; cutoff inherited from price source, no outcome-based date selection

universe.company_group: Dated issuer CIK and attested successor identity; multi-class company counted once
universe.held_security: Lexicographically first current S&P listed common class within the verified company; rank/weight by company cap; unlisted common classes included only under documented economic-equivalence total-cap convention
universe.missing_boundary: For each K separately, block if any missing member or company/class cap without a defensible upper bound can reach the K cutoff; publish uncertainty, never assign zero
universe.primary: All companies in the S&P500 dated membership strictly before signal; include Financials, Real Estate and unclassified sectors; no four-factor requirement
qualifications: Official dated full-index float-cap rank only if membership, company/class mapping and index float capitalization are verified
Observed-snapshot reported-total-cap results must be separately labelled; do not call them index float capitalization
Corrected-financial-pool results labelled with that entire pool; incomplete cap coverage blocks K, no survivors-only re-ranking
